examples: open https://example.com/pricing and tell me what the plans cost
can you read this link for me? https://news.example.org/story/4821
whats on this page https://example.com/about

check if https://example.com is up and what it says on the front page

go to example.com/contact and find the support email
grab the content of https://example.org/changelog, i want to see what's new
read this url and tell me if the recipe needs eggs https://food.example.com/pancakes
